div.head: II Ew 5.1
div.ab: Gif he ðonne nelle, ðolige ure ealra freodscipes ⁊ ealles ðæs ðe he age.
Gif he ðonne nelle, ðolige ure ealra freonscipes ⁊ ealles ðæs ðe he age.
Si autem nolit, perdat omnium nostrum amiciciam et omne quod habebit.
Gif he þonne nelle, ðolige ure ealra freonscipes ⁊ ealles ðæs ðe he age.
If, however, he is not willing to do this, he shall forfeit the friendship of all of us, and all that he possesses.
Wenn er aber [dessen] sich weigert, verliere er unser aller Freundschaft und alles, was er besitzt.
But if he refuses [this], let him lose the friendship of all of us and everything that he owns.
div.note: H reads ‘freonscipes’; Liebermann emends to ‘freodscipes’ from Ld.
